import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import planning_stats as P
import ledger as L
T, N = chr(9), chr(10)
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
def cli(path):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/planning_stats.py', str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
def table(rows):
    return N.join(T.join(cols) for cols in rows) + N
def row(seat, model, **counts):
    return dict(type='architect-run', seat=seat, model=model, **counts)
rows = [row('a', 'x', input_tokens=1, output_tokens=2, cache_read_tokens=7), row('a', 'x', input_tokens=10, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=20, thinking_tokens=500), row('a', 'x', input_tokens=10, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=20, thinking_tokens=500), row('b', 'y', input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=0), row('b', 'y', input_tokens=5, output_tokens=5), row('b', 'y', input_tokens=40, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=60), dict(type='review', seat='a', model='x', input_tokens=999, output_tokens=999, cache_read_tokens=999)]
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
data = tmp / 'routing-data.jsonl'
data.write_text(N.join(json.dumps(r) for r in rows) + N, encoding='utf-8')
want = {'groups': [{'seat': 'a', 'model': 'x', 'runs': 2, 'median_total': 20}, {'seat': 'b', 'model': 'y', 'runs': 1, 'median_total': 100}], 'all': {'runs': 3, 'median_total': 30}, 'duplicates': 1, 'unmeasured': 2}
got = P.summarize(data)
assert got == want, got
out = cli(data)
assert (out.returncode, out.stdout, out.stderr) == (0, table([['seat', 'model', 'runs', 'median_total'], ['a', 'x', '2', '20'], ['b', 'y', '1', '100'], ['all', 'all', '3', '30'], ['duplicates', '1'], ['unmeasured', '2']]), ''), out
bad = tmp / 'bad.jsonl'
bad.write_text('{' + N, encoding='utf-8')
out = cli(bad)
assert (out.returncode, out.stdout) == (2, '') and out.stderr.startswith('planning_stats: '), out
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
base = pathlib.Path('tests/fixtures/planning-stats/2a-baseline-routing-data.jsonl')
raw = base.read_bytes()
orig = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', '06481fd:docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/routing-data.jsonl'], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob %d' % len(orig) + bytes(1) + orig).hexdigest() == '745971d1075b267725f94f8365e258caa2751058', 'git show 06481fd did not return the 2A baseline blob'
NEW = b'ghp-/github-pat-'
OLD = NEW.replace(b'-', b'_')
assert (len(raw), raw.count(N.encode()), raw.count(NEW), raw.count(OLD), orig.count(OLD), orig.count(NEW)) == (66755, 247, 1, 0, 1, 0), 'baseline fixture is not the 06481fd file with the one documented scrub'
assert raw.replace(NEW, OLD) == orig, 'baseline fixture differs from 06481fd beyond the documented scrub'
lines, old_lines = raw.decode('utf-8').split(N)[:-1], orig.decode('utf-8').split(N)[:-1]
assert [n for n, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(lines, old_lines), 1) if a != b] == [38], 'the scrub must change line 38 only'
assert json.loads(lines[37])['run_id'] == '4eee8795-b8bf-4dc4-9c89-fe2eeb4b0ff8' and L.SECRET_PATTERNS[2].pattern == 'github_pat_' and L.SECRET_PATTERNS[2].search(old_lines[37]), 'line 38 is not the row that tripped the github_pat_ rule'
def private(line):
    return bool(L.EMAIL.search(line) or L.ABSOLUTE_PATH.search(line) or any(p.search(line) for p in L.SECRET_PATTERNS))
assert not any(private(line) for line in lines), [n for n, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if private(line)]
real = P.summarize(base)
assert real == {'groups': [{'seat': 'agy.brain', 'model': 'claude-opus-5-5-high', 'runs': 1, 'median_total': 1585010}, {'seat': 'agy.premium', 'model': 'gemini-4-argon-high', 'runs': 24, 'median_total': 1139698}, {'seat': 'claude.brain-planning', 'model': 'claude opus (high)', 'runs': 11, 'median_total': 2033553}], 'all': {'runs': 36, 'median_total': 1250599}, 'duplicates': 3, 'unmeasured': 2}, real
out = cli(base)
assert (out.returncode, out.stdout, out.stderr) == (0, table([['seat', 'model', 'runs', 'median_total'], ['agy.brain', 'claude-opus-5-5-high', '1', '1585010'], ['agy.premium', 'gemini-4-argon-high', '24', '1139698'], ['claude.brain-planning', 'claude opus (high)', '11', '2033553'], ['all', 'all', '36', '1250599'], ['duplicates', '3'], ['unmeasured', '2']]), ''), out
for name in ('scripts/planning_stats.py', 'tests/test-planning-stats.py'):
    assert '20261014-2a-foundation' not in pathlib.Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), name + ' names the live 2A directory'
assert 'def test_frozen_2a_baseline' in pathlib.Path('tests/test-planning-stats.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
own = json.loads(pathlib.Path('harness-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['ownership']
for key in ('install_payload_paths', 'update_paths'):
    assert own[key].count('scripts/planning_stats.py') == 1, key
print('ok')
